LaSalle Parish Clerk of Court in Jena, LA: Services, Hours, and Contact Info

Location & Contact Details
Address: 1050 Courthouse St, Room 24, Jena, LA 71342
Hours of Operation:

  • Monday–Friday: 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM
  • Saturday & Sunday: Closed
    Phone: +1 (318) 992-2158
    Website: LaSalle Parish Clerk of Court
    Google Maps: Directions to LaSalle Parish Clerk of Court

Introduction
The LaSalle Parish Clerk of Court in Jena, Louisiana, is a cornerstone of local government, bridging residents with essential legal and administrative services. From marriage licenses to passport processing, this office ensures seamless access to critical records and public resources.

Key Services Offered
The Clerk of Court provides vital services to LaSalle Parish residents, including:
 Marriage Licenses
 Notary Public Certifications
 Legal Document Recording (deeds, mortgages)
 Passport Application Processing
 Court Document Filing
 Public Record Maintenance

Detailed Service Overview

1. Marriage Licenses in LaSalle Parish

  • Process: Both partners must visit the office with valid ID (e.g., driver’s license, birth certificate).
  • Fee: Check the website for current rates.
  • Waiting Period: Licenses are typically issued immediately.

2. Notary Public Services

  • Requirements: Bring unsigned documents and valid photo ID.
  • Walk-ins: Available during office hours; no appointment needed.

3. Recording Legal Documents

  • Steps: Submit documents in person with payment. Fees vary by document type.
  • Online Access: View recorded deeds/mortgages via the official website.

4. Passport Applications

  • Documents Needed: Birth certificate, photo ID, passport photo.
  • Processing Time: Allow 6–8 weeks for standard service.

5. Filing Court Documents

  • Guidance: Staff assists with filings for civil, criminal, or family court cases.
  • Fees: Vary by case type; confirm costs beforehand.

How to Access Services

  • In-Person: Visit Room 24 at the courthouse address above.
  • Online: Access records, forms, and fee payments via lasalleclerk.com.
  • Phone/Email: Call +1 (318) 992-2158 for queries.

Fees & Charges
Fees depend on the service (e.g., marriage licenses, passport processing). For a full list, visit the Fee Schedule online.

History & Community Role
Established with LaSalle Parish’s founding, the Clerk of Court has evolved into a modern hub for legal and administrative needs. It preserves parish records, ensuring transparency and accessibility for historical and legal purposes.

Why This Office Matters

  • Maintains public records critical for property, legal, and personal matters.
  • Streamlines passport and marriage applications locally.
  • Offers notary services for document authentication.

FAQs

Q: What’s the cost for a marriage license?
A: Fees vary; check the website or call for updated rates.

Q: Can I file court documents online?
A: Some filings are available online; inquire via phone or website.

Q: Do I need an appointment for notary services?
A: No—walk-ins are welcome during business hours.

Q: How long does passport processing take?
A: Typically 6–8 weeks; expedited options may cost extra.

Conclusion
The LaSalle Parish Clerk of Court is an indispensable resource for Jena residents, offering efficient access to legal, administrative, and record-keeping services. Whether you’re planning a wedding, buying a home, or need a passport, this office ensures your needs are met with expertise.
